records.text: Owens said Danny Phillips was hired in May 2025 and, according to LinkedIn, graduated from Ohio State University.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Like I said, Danny Phillips was hired in May of 2025. According to his LinkedIn, he graduated from Ohio State University.

verification.notes: Daniel Philip’s public profile confirms Ohio State attendance from 2021 to 2025 and current TPUSA employment. A current profile aggregator dates his TPUSA associate-producer role to January 2025, not May, so the graduation portion is supported but the stated hire month is not.

records.text: Owens said Phillips ran or participated in the Turning Point chapter at Ohio State and then went straight to work for Turning Point USA.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's correct. He was running the Turning Point chapter at Ohio State University or was a part of the Turning Point chapter. ... And then he went straight to work for Turning Point USA.

verification.notes: Philip’s public profile lists him as president of Ohio State’s TPUSA chapter from February 2022 through April 2025 and currently employed by TPUSA. Ohio State’s student newspaper independently identified him as chapter president in 2023.
